calculation.description: Cross-asset reversal signal: assets with weaker five-day returns relative to their trailing 20-day daily volatility receive higher scores. The signal is evaluated using only information available at the date cutoff.

validation.regime_notes: Overall daily IC and ICIR clear benchmark gates, with positive IC in all three chronological thirds. ICIR was 0.12323 in 2020-2022, 0.09320 in 2023-2024, and 0.06836 in 2025-2026; recent 250-date ICIR was 0.06651, indicating performance drift and requiring monitoring. Small cross-section is the full 15-asset tradable universe; every IC date had at least 8 valid instruments.
